message.content:
As of today — May 13, 2026 — the Vice President of the United States is **Kamala D. Harris**.  
She took office on January 20, 2021 when President Joseph R. Biden began his first term.  

(If you’re looking at events beyond early 2025, please let me know—I’ll check whether any recent developments have altered the line‑of‑succession.)
